title: Vangphat tin konna
lyrics:
Vangphat tin konna Chung Pathen,
Lhai cheh un Van Mitheng jousen,
Lhaicheh un noiya mijousen,
Apa, Acha, Lhagao-Theng chu, Amen.

title: Kaki khop nau
lyrics:
Kaki khop nau kikhen nung le,
Pathen in neiumpi jing un,
Ka lungu le ka chennau in,
Na-Intheng hijing hen Pathen, Amen.

title: Vanchung a um kapau
lyrics:
1. Vanchung a um Kapau Pathen,
Neilungset nau hiche An hi,
Ka jondiu ahitai, keihon,
Hijeh chun Nang kahin lhaijui.

2. Leiset An neipeh bang u hin,
Lhagao An in jong neivah un,
Thahat lungnem Lhagao hinna,
Neipeuvin hinlai damsung in.

title: Pakai neingah jingun
lyrics:
1. Pakai kei neingah jing un,
Setto kichat dal’in,
Tujan ka ihmut laiseu vin,
Jing khovah kit kahsen.
Nisa che dungjuiya,
Chonphat lam kahin thei na din,
Tha neipen neivah un.

title: Van’a kapau pathen
lyrics:
1. Van a Kapau Pathen
Ka gam sunguva hin phattheina lhan,
Ka damtheina diu le lungmon le olna din,
Hahom in phattheina, na chon nem pha.

2. Na Lhagao Theng tah chu,
Haosa jouse lung a chensah in,
Chaga jong hahom’in thunun na le lungnem,
Chonphat le chon nem in gam losoh hen.

title: Jesu melhoi in
lyrics:
1. Jesu melhoi in kalung sung salvah hen,
Ami ngailut kidang tah le theng tah chu,
Kalung a achen teng,
Kalung mong jing ta ding,
Jesu melhoi in kalungsung salvah in.

title: Pathen in ching jing in
lyrics:
Damselin Pathen in ching in,
Damselin Pathen in ching in,
Damselin Pathen in ching in,
Ikimuto kit kahsen.

title: Veovin tunin nangho jouse
lyrics:
1. Veuvin tunin nangho jouse din
Kipana Thupha kahinpoi. (Fine)

	Mijousen kipah in
	La saovin D.S.

title: An hung nen
lyrics:
An hungnen Pakai jin,
Nakou hung nen,
Nangman Jesu Ankong,
Um jing jeng ta ding,
Mi sang nga vahva pa chun,
Agilkel te koupa chun,
Nakouve............Amen.

title: Neithah semkit’uvin
lyrics:
Neitah semkit’ uvin,
O ! Thaneipen Pathen!
Huhhing kachan theina diuvin
Namai vah chun neisal vah-uvin.

title: Neikan khom un pakai
lyrics:
Neikan khom un Pakai (2)
Gutan louvin neikan khom un.
Neikan khom un Pakai (2) 
Ngailut nan neikan khom un,
Pathen khatseh ahi,
Leng jong khatseh bou
Tahsa jong khatseh bou
Tahsa jong pumkhat sehbou,
Lan vahchoi-jute.

title: Hiche bou kahei
lyrics:
Hiche bou kahei (2)
Pathen mikhoto na kidang
Chonse thina’a kon eilhat doh,
Tuma a mitchon kho kamutai,
Hiche bou kahei.

title: Hossana chungnung pen’a
lyrics:
Hossana (3) Chungnung pen’a (2)
Na min ka domsang ui,
Lung kipana dimset in,
Choi-at na Nang a hihen Pakai
Hossana Chungnung pen’a.

title: Pathen kelngoiching
lyrics:
1. Pathen Kelngoiching keima
Lhahsam na neipong’e
Nitin in kamachal jing’e
Leiset boihen hahsat na toh jong leng
Nungchon kit pong’e.

2. Loupina lallukhuh chu,
Lungut in na tong un,
Pakai nikho alhin teng leh,
Itohphat man Pakaijin eipeh teng,
Nalung lhainadem?

title: Navah domsang un
lyrics:
[CHORUS_START]
Navah domsang un Vangam sepaite (3)
Navah chu leiset kimvel’a.
[CHORUS_END]

1. Aw Sopi navah chu domsangun (3) Navah
2. Aw Pate navah chu domsang un (3) chu
3. Aw Nute navah chu domsang un (3) leiset
4. Aw Chate navah chu domsang un (3).kimvel a

title: Herod lengpa
lyrics:
1. Herod lengpa chule,
Amite jouse Jerusalem khopia:
Lungdonna meipin abom Leng apen chu,
Christa hoiya peng ham?

2. Juda gam Bethelehem.
I sah lou helun aneopen jong hilou:
Ka mite ching ding khat peng ding ahi,
Tin themgaovin asei.

title: Na um em Pakai Cross a kikhaiya
lyrics:
1. Na um em Pakai Cross a kikhaiya (2)

[CHORUS_START]
Hichun phat khat, phat khat:
Eiki thinsah, thinsah, thinsah,
Na um em Pakai Cross’a kikhaiya?
[CHORUS_END]

2. Na um em thinga akhet beh - uva? (2)
3. Na um em Anah teng asut uva? (2)
4. Na um em nisan sal ding ada’a? (2)
5. Na um em lhana alup sah - uva? (2)

title: Mi tin het ding dol ahi
lyrics:
[CHORUS_START]
Mi tin het ding dol ahi (2)
Mi tin het ding dol ahi, Jesu koi ham.
[CHORUS_END]

1. Ama phaicham lily ahi,
Ama vah jing jeng valpa,
Sangsom lah-a hoipen Ama,
Mi tin hetding dol ahi.
2. Cross’a chonse te din athi,
Athisanin buh bang so,
Lungset hing jing, hung ding Pakai,
Nahet ding Ama ahi.

title: Sun le jan in
lyrics:
[CHORUS_START]
Sun le jan in Vantil’in neingah jingin Pakai (2)
[CHORUS_END]

1. Tun ihmudin kalumtai,
Vantil’in neingah jing in Pakai,
Kalha ngahdin kataove,
Vantil’in neingah jing in.

2. Katho kaha kathi le
Vantil’in neingah jing in Pakai,
Kalha ladin kataove,
Vantil’in neingah jing in.
